## Result

Proposed status: `claimed_solved`, 2/5 substantive approaches. An explicit compact smooth autonomous Hamiltonian has an invariant band of normalized full Liouville volume 1/4, with all four Lyapunov exponents zero and no positive-measure invariant region whose Koopman representation is almost periodic. Each energy component already fails almost periodicity.

## Scope and review

The ambient symplectic form is nonexact. This claims the unrestricted smooth symplectic formulation, with almost periodicity defined as precompact L2 Koopman orbits. It does not claim a standard Euclidean, exact-cotangent, analytic, natural-mechanical, contact-type, generic, or weakly-mixing example. Knill's 2016 terminology and the audit's additional pointwise Bohr check corroborate the interpretation; they are not presented as a formal definition in the 2000 source.

Complete candidate and independent AI audit are unrefereed, with no novelty or historical-priority claim. Classical skew-shift and mapping-torus mechanisms are used. No mandatory proof correction was found by the audit.

## Preserved artifacts and checks

- Original 12-file candidate and 11-file audit are unchanged, with separate release note.
- Author: 3,248 exact checks and six controls.
- Independent: 2,460 exact checks and eight additional controls.
- Four strict-manifest mutation controls rejected edited proof, extra file, missing file, and same-content symlink.
- Final-layout replay passed; all original bytes remained unchanged.
- Queue edit changes only this row's Status, Turns, and previously blank Findings; all other bytes and existing header preserved.
